verdict.rationale: Lorikeet's own documentation describes generating simulations from actual tickets and running them in bulk, replaying historical tickets and synthetic scenarios to project resolution quality before deployment, plus adversarial guardrail test scenarios and side-by-side batch comparisons. Both halves of the story are covered: historical-ticket replay and simulated conversations. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the simulation feature (all evidence is vendor-claimed).

support.subject: As a support ops lead, I test the agent against historical tickets or simulated conversations before it faces real customers

citations.quote: Generate simulations straight from your actual tickets and run them in bulk batches, so every workflow change is tested against the conversations your customers actually have.
Replay historical tickets and synthetic scenarios in bulk to see projected resolution quality and knowledge gaps, then deploy on the topics the agent is trained for
run them as guardrail test scenarios so you know how the agent responds before a real user tries the same tricks.
Side-by-side batch comparisons show how a workflow edit changed outcomes across hundreds of scenarios, with per-conversation drill-downs when you need to understand a single result.
